name: lucid-rebrand
note: The rebrand for diagrams, by the diagram skill's roles. Values are the design-system tokens in theme/rebrand.css (from lv-red-team-v0-1/deck.css); bad-soft is the one derived value (the bad red at about 15% on paper). Deck-local for the TechGov talk; to be upstreamed to the diagram skill as themes/lucid.json. Lint with scripts/lint-diagram.py, which measures labels with these fonts. crux is the crux mark and is used for nothing else.
